backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting domain update to 'awake01' and related files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each frontend file’s role in the Keep Awake app.
frontend/deployment/domain.json: Defines production domain 'awake01' and documents platform naming constraints.
frontend/deployment/README.md: Explains production domain 'awake01', naming rules, and redeployment steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React app root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component wiring wake lock, timer, settings, visibility handling, and UI layout.
Renders preset duration buttons including an unlimited option for configuring timer length.
frontend/src/components/SettingsPanel.ts: Settings card with toggles and selectors for auto-start, visibility behavior, default duration, and mouse jiggle.
Displays a status badge reflecting app state or error condition.
frontend/src/components/UnsupportedNotic: Alert shown when Wake Lock API is unsupported, explaining limitations and alternatives.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity with automatic refetching.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdownTimer.ts: Implements a countdown timer with start, stop, reset, and expiration callback.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling login, stored identities, and status tracking.
Manages keep‑awake user settings stored in localStorage with defaults and an update helper.
Custom hook syncing React state with localStorage and cross‑tab updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useMouseJiggle.ts: Triggers periodic synthetic mousemove events when enabled to help prevent sleep.
frontend/src/hooks/usePageLifecycle.ts: Tracks page visibility and supports optional before‑unload callbacks.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder module exporting nothing for now.
frontend/src/hooks/useWakeLock.ts: Wraps the Screen Wake Lock API with request/release logic and error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and a warm light/dark theme via CSS variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme tokens, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing features, issues, deployment notes, and app purpose.
